incident.location_detail: Lounge side door to hack floor west, then walking toward the SW stairwell and the catering counter
incident.evidence_of_threat: Subject passed within 2 m of 6 attendees on hack floor west. Temperature in his wake read 12C against a floor lux of 280 and IR skin temp of 15.9C — a localized cold wake inconsistent with the ambient environment. The garlic braid on the main door never moved, and blinds on the east side were still down, so the report does not establish that the subject entered through the main entrance or that any ritual deterrent was tested. 42 of 61 attendees on the floor are refusing to leave their desks because submissions close in 10 minutes, and two staff are pulling attendees by the sleeve, so the floor is not in a controlled evacuation state.
incident.ordinary_explanation: A tall attendee or staff member simply walked from the lounge onto the hack floor and toward the stairwell and catering counter ahead of the 18:30 dinner. The 12C reading in his wake is the one measurement that does not fit an ordinary pedestrian, but it is a single point reading with no calibration reference, no repeat measurement, and no comparison to ambient IR readings elsewhere on the floor; it could equally be a sensor artifact, a reading taken near a cold surface or an open door, or a mis-scoped IR spot. The garlic braid and the east blinds are negative indicators that carry little weight: the braid was on the main door and the subject demonstrably entered via the lounge side door, and the blinds were never raised, so neither was actually tested against the subject.

incident.location_detail: first-aid corner, hack floor east
incident.evidence_of_threat: Nine people injured: six with bite marks and three with scratches. Dana, Priya and Theo are back in human form but febrile (37.8C, 37.9C, 38.0C) and Theo's forearm wound bled freely. Moon altitude 5 degrees and 93% lit at 20:26, setting 11:52 tomorrow, consistent with a full moon night. Two individuals (B-0233, B-0418) are stable but were apparently also involved.
incident.ordinary_explanation: A full moon was up and the three named individuals were recently transformed back to human form with low-grade fever and fresh bite/scratch wounds; the injuries and fever are consistent with an actual creature attack rather than a mundane accident. No evidence of a mundane cause for the bite marks is offered.
incident.summary: At 20:26 in the first-aid corner of hack floor east, with 160 of 160 attendees present and the event ending at 20:30, nine people are injured (six bite marks, three scratches). Dana, Priya and Theo have reverted to human form with fevers of 37.8C, 37.9C and 38.0C, wrapped in blankets and asking for water; Theo's forearm wound bled freely. B-0233 and B-0418 are stable. Moon altitude 5 degrees, 93% lit, sets 11:52 tomorrow. Doors latched, guard posted on the street side. Lobby lux 900, floor temp 21C. Organizers are asking whether the bitten should be released home or kept under watch overnight.
